dex.entry: The Lost Hour — the keeper of a dawn that has not come, waiting half-finished where the morning was meant to land. Those who meet it say the worst part is its patience: it does not doubt the sunrise, and it will not be told the years.

art.silhouette: A tall, slender hare of pale gold light, mid-stride even when standing. Long ears trail behind it like horizon ribbons. Parts of its outline are UNFINISHED — one hindquarter and the tip of one ear fade into faint sketch-lines of light, as if the painter stopped at the moment the dawn did. The missing parts must read as waiting, not wounded.
art.palette: Bone (#f5f0e1) and pale gold body; a sunrise gradient of rose and amber along the spine and ear-ribbons; the unfinished edges in faint diamond-cyan (#9fe7ff) sketch-lines over transparency.
art.direction: An unfinished sunrise as a creature — fast, gentle, heartbreaking. The emotional apex of the triad: in the Long Dusk it is incomplete by definition, and the sprite should make the player want to fix that.
